blocks.text: Carbon ke do oxides hain: carbon monoxide (CO) aur carbon dioxide (CO₂).
Carbon monoxide (CO) zyada tar fossil fuels ke incomplete combustion (na-mukammal jalne, yani kam oxygen mein jalne) se banti hai:

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Carbon monoxide bohat zehreeli (poisonous) gas hai; saans ke saath andar jaye to dam ghut-ta hai (suffocation). Yeh khoon ke hemoglobin ke saath oxygen se zyada mazbooti se jur jati hai, is liye oxygen saans ke aam amal mein shamil nahi ho pati. Zyada pressure wali oxygen de kar CO ke zehar ka asar khatam kiya ja sakta hai.

Carbon dioxide sab se aham greenhouse gas hai jo insani kaamon, jaise fossil fuels jalane, se hawa mein aati hai. CO₂ ek primary greenhouse gas hai jo atmosphere mein garmi rok leti hai (traps heat), aur is se global warming hoti hai:

blocks.caption: Carbon ke oxides
rows: hemoglobin se jurti hai, dam ghut-ta hai; ilaj: zyada pressure wali oxygen

blocks.prompt: Kaun si aam insani activity hawa mein carbon monoxide barhati hai, aur CO thori miqdar mein bhi khatarnak kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Petrol (gasoline) se chalne wali gariyan, jin ke engines fuel poori tarah nahi jalate. CO is liye khatarnak hai ke hemoglobin ise oxygen se kahin zyada mazbooti se pakarta hai; thori CO bhi khoon ki oxygen le jane ki salahiyat rok deti hai.

items: Incomplete combustion se CO (2C + O₂ → 2CO): hemoglobin se jur kar zehar ka kaam karti hai.
Complete combustion se CO₂ (C + O₂ → CO₂): garmi rokne wali primary greenhouse gas.
